schemaMatches.quantity: per-view hierarchical depth pyramid; HZBClosest stores the max (nearest) device Z, HZBFurthest stores the min (farthest) device Z of each 2x2 depth quad
schemaMatches.units: device Z in [0,1] (reversed Z: larger = nearer; 0 = far plane)
schemaMatches.coordinateSpace: HZB texture UV [0,1] over HZBSize(mip0); viewport -> HZB scales by ViewRect.Size()/(2*HZBSize)

transforms.name: mipReduce
transforms.expression: mip m = 2x2 reduction of mip m-1; HZBSize=max(pow2(ViewRect)/2,1); NumMips=max(floor(log2(max(HZBSize))),1); footprint mip = log2(footprint)

mathTerms: Reversed Z: min DeviceZ = furthest surface, max DeviceZ = closest (HZB.usf:277-282).
Capture 1048576 B = base mip 1024x512x2; full 10-mip chain is larger, so the descriptor byte count covers mip0 only.
ClosestDeviceZ = f16(maxZ)+1 (next FP16) so the tested nearest occluder is conservative.
gaps: Exact view extent is not in ResourceDescs metadata; 1024x512 is derived from the captured byte count and HZBSize=pow2/2.

fields.name: ClosestDeviceZ
fields.decode: RoundUpF16(max of the 2x2 device-Z quad); rounding up keeps the closest occluder conservative
